Round 4 — Hiring Manager

After the HLD round, there was a wait of roughly a week before the next round was scheduled.

The Hiring Manager round had some scheduling issues initially. On the first scheduled date, the interviewer didn’t join, so the round had to be rescheduled.

* Projects I had worked on

* Difficult technical problems I had handled

* CI/CD pipeline
* How my team operated
* My role and responsibilities within the team
* General engineering and ownership-related questions

From my perspective, this was a very good discussion. I was able to answer the questions confidently, and the conversation was quite detailed.
